# Do dash weapons work if the bot dashes more

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | movement |
| Result | inconclusive |
| Created | L1.I3 |
| Updated | L1.I10 |

## Hypothesis

Dash-triggered weapons (mash-landing, julienne-dash, afterburner-fries) never fire at dashThreshold 0.5, because the bot never dashes. A threshold of 0.2 makes it dash and these weapons deal damage, with or without costing health.

## Method

Fresh Nightmare 1 game on seed 11 for 180 s with mash-landing, julienne-dash and afterburner-fries, spry-sprout, butter-socks and golden-fry, and dashThreshold 0.2. Compare dash count and damage by weapon against the earlier games, which had 0 dashes.

## Findings

Dash weapons fire only if the bot dashes. At 0.2 it dashed 37 times and julienne-dash dealt 4025 damage, but the game ended at 28/120 health with fewer kills than the 0.5 control (685 against 789, 5 dashes, health 103/120). The builds diverged after the chests, so more dashing is neither shown to help nor to hurt. Fresh peel-phantom was the worst start. Rehearsal and I9 games dashed only at low health.
